parole.significato: shark (scaleless, sharp-toothed predatory fish of the superorder Selachimorpha)
parole.testo: From Icelandic hái (compare há- (“of or pertaining to shark kind”)), a short form of hákarl (“a shark”), a compound of hár (“high, great”) and karl (“man”); and zivs (“fish”). Probably a calque of German Haifisch.
